notes.title: Portuguese Build Live
notes.content:
[h1]Portuguese![/h1]
The entire game is now playable in Portuguese, kindly translated by the amazing people at NG+ (New Game Plus) in São Paulo (and my friend Max)! Go check their event out for all kinds of amazing LGBTQ+ games!

[h2]Achievement Fixes[/h2]
Fixed the "Way Past Oblivion, I Guess" achievement, as well as updated some descriptions to make things clear. Thanks for bringing this to my attention!
